subject: Unexpected 429 Too Many Requests in Staging Sandbox environment
body:
Hello,

We are testing our load simulator in the Staging sandbox environment and hitting HTTP 429 Too Many Requests after only 15 calls to /v2/analytics/reports. The staging quota is supposed to be 100 req/sec.

Workaround: We have temporarily enabled local caching which keeps us testing, but the rate limit misconfiguration should be fixed.

SDK: mermail-node-v3.2.0
Environment: Staging
Request ID: req_stg_44129b

Thanks,
Dave
